title: Meta Instagram App Secret placeholders, references, masks and empty values
summary: The client_secret field or parameter holding an angle placeholder, an environment reference, a template reference, a masked display or no value, and prose that names the field.
rationale: Meta's sample requests show client_secret as a short placeholder (claim instagram-docs-use-short-placeholder-secret) and the pages state no format. A placeholder, a reference, a masked display and an empty field stand in for a value kept elsewhere and carry none. No Instagram App ID appears: its public status is not stated, so the case asserts nothing about it. Contract claims cited: instagram-app-secret/instagram-docs-use-short-placeholder-secret.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#243). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no secret value. That a placeholder, reference, masked display or empty field is not a value is the project's decision; Meta documents the placeholder form (documentation fact only).

sources.supports: client_secret set to your app's Instagram App Secret from the App Dashboard

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
